English: Brush Fence
A makeshift defensive fence of brush, brambles, and sharpened sticks, swiftly thrown up by newly arrived clans as a basic deterrent to wild beasts and raiders.
Wooden Palisade
Timber palisades encircle the camp, offering improved protection and a sense of permanence. Watchfires burn at night, and the clan feels more secure.
Stone Rampart
A low stone rampart replaces the wood, signaling growing wealth and stability. Skilled masons reinforce weak spots, and the wall now deters all but the most determined attackers.
Gatehouse
A sturdy gatehouse controls entry to the settlement. Guards are posted day and night, greatly bolstering security and morale.
Defended Hall
The central hall is fortified, serving as a rallying point in emergencies. The clans core is now a true bastion, with defenders on constant alert.
Watchtower Pavilion
Tall timber watchtowers with sheltered lookout pavilions ring the settlement, offering early warning of any threat and safe vantage points for archers.
Bastion Room
Thick-walled bastion rooms are added to the inner defenses, offering a last line of shelter and command for the clans leaders and warriors.
Chiefs Chamber
A grand chamber is constructed for the clan chief, symbolizing unity and prestige. The chamber is a gathering place for council and strategy.
High Wall Pavilion
Magnificent stone walls, reinforced with timber galleries and ceremonial pavilions, rise above the settlement. The clan is safe and respected.
South Slavic Fortress
A formidable stronghold, blending nomadic tradition with South Slavic craftsmanship. The fortress is the heart of the clans power, unity, and defense.
